attributes.action: Make Violent and Repeat Domestic Abuse Offenders Serve Their Full Sentences
attributes.additional_details: I am a victim of domestic abuse living with the lasting trauma and fear caused by the crimes committed against me. It is wrong that violent and repeat offenders can be released early while victims continue to live with the consequences. Court sentences must mean what they say. Victims’ safety must come first, and dangerous domestic abuse offenders should serve the full sentences they receive.
attributes.background: Protect victims by banning early release for violent and repeat domestic abuse offenders.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Make those convicted for domestic abuse ineligible for early release" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/769478
